_readme: Save a copy as server-env.json in the same folder as Help → Open workspace sync folder. Use the same FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL, and FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY as your hosted deployment (e.g. Vercel). Private key must use \n for newlines inside the JSON string. To enable AI without saving a session cookie, set GOOGLE_API_KEY (or GEMINI_API_KEY). Restart the desktop app after saving.
